title: On the structures of {diamond, bowtie}-free graphs that do not contain an induced subdivision of $K_4$
summary: A graph is $\mathrm{ISK}_4$-free if it contains no induced subdivision of $K_4$. Lévêque et al. [\emph{J. Combin. Theory Ser. B} \textbf{102} (2012) 924--947] conjectured that all $\mathrm{ISK}_4$-free graphs are 4-colorable. Chen et al. [\emph{J. Graph Theory} \textbf{96} (2021) 554--577] proved that $\{\mathrm{ISK}_4, \mathrm{diamond}, \mathrm{bowtie}\}$-free graphs are 4-colorable and asked whether such graphs are 3-colorable, where a diamond is $K_4$ minus one edge and a bowtie consists of two triangles sharing a vertex.
